title: Daily workflow
description: What to run when developing templates or the shared core starter kit.

blocks.text: Edit the template folder directly. No sync.

blocks.code:
edit templates/hotel-website-template/
pnpm dev:hotel
# or: cd templates/hotel-website-template && pnpm dev

blocks.text: Only when you changed packages/core and want existing templates to pick up those files:
pnpm sync-templates:check shows whether templates still match core. Pre-commit no longer forces sync — propagate is intentional.
Run validate before version bumps. Run diff-core before propagate. Full scenarios and internals: see Validate & diff-core page.

blocks.code:
tempjs version check
edit templates/hotel-website-template/CHANGELOG.md
tempjs version inc minor hotel
tempjs version inc patch cli   # if CLI changed
git commit
npm publish                  # CLI only, when ready
